def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    color = min((v for v in counts if v != 0), key=counts.get)
    shape = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in shape)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in shape)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in shape]
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1

    for r in range(len(grid) - sh + 1):
